title: Infare
html_source:
Infare: An entrance or reception; a celebration given for a new home, esp. after a wedding.

From Middle English infer (“entrance”), from Old English infær (“ingress, entrance, ingang”), from Proto-Germanic in + farą (“a going”), corresponding to in- +‎ fare.
